metadata.title: Human-Centered AI Deployment Readiness Protocol: Engineering-Handoff Profile
metadata.description: A proposed, unvalidated engineering-handoff evaluation protocol with separate evaluator and reference materials, calculation workbooks, a synthetic instructional case, technical correction records and a comparative validation plan. The method synthesizes established usability and human-AI evaluation concepts. No empirical effectiveness, independent peer review, organizational adoption or NIST endorsement is claimed. Development and technical review were assisted by OpenAI Codex. Original documents and synthetic data: CC BY 4.0; original software: MIT.
